title: Project-Structure
text:
Each project in RStudio should follow a consistent directory structure.
project/ │ ├── R/ │ scripts for reusable functions │ ├── analysis/ │ numbered analysis scripts │ ├── data_raw/ │ original raw data (never edited) │ ├── data_processed/ │ cleaned or derived datasets │ ├── output/ │ figures and tables │ ├── docs/ │ rendered reports │ ├── renv/ │ package environment │ ├── project.Rproj │ └── README.md

title: Project-Structure
text:
2.1 R/
Reusable functions used across analyses.
Example:
R/ clean_sensor_data.R plot_air_quality.R download_epa_data.R

title: Project-Structure
text:
2.2 analysis/
Sequential analysis scripts.
Example:
analysis/ 01_download_epa_data.R 02_clean_data.R 03_merge_datasets.R 04_generate_figures.R

title: Project-Structure
text:
2.3 data_raw/
Raw data should never be modified.
Examples:

EPA downloads
sensor network data
instrument exports

title: Project-Structure
text:
2.4 data_processed/
Cleaned datasets used for analysis.

title: Project-Structure
text:
2.5 output/
Generated figures and tables (in separate subfolders).

title: Workflow Manual for Environmental Data Projects
text:
This manual describes a standardized workflow for managing environmental data analysis projects using R, GitHub, and reproducible research practices.
The goal is to make projects:

reproducible
collaborative
well organized
easy to archive and revisit later

The workflow described here is designed for projects involving:

environmental monitoring data
sensor networks
geospatial environmental data
collaborative research teams

title: Workflow Manual for Environmental Data Projects
text:
2.1 1. Reproducibility
All analyses should be reproducible from raw data to final figures using scripts.

title: Workflow Manual for Environmental Data Projects
text:
2.2 2. Version Control
All code and documentation are tracked using Git and hosted on GitHub.

title: Workflow Manual for Environmental Data Projects
text:
2.3 3. Clear Project Structure
Projects follow a consistent directory structure so collaborators can easily understand the workflow.

title: Workflow Manual for Environmental Data Projects
text:
2.4 4. Dependency Management
The R package environment is locked using renv to ensure long-term reproducibility.
